metadata.name: Echo Location
metadata.description: A three-player cooperative submarine game about interpreting private visual and audio reports before the Captain commits to a maneuver.

teams.name: Submarine Crew
teams.description: Work together to navigate three hazards before the submarine runs out of oxygen.

categories.name: Observer
categories.description: Receives private hazard information and reports what they perceive.

categories.name: Commander
categories.description: Combines the crew's reports and commits to a maneuver.

abilities.name: Ascend
abilities.description: Commit the submarine to an upward maneuver for the current hazard.

abilities.name: Dive
abilities.description: Commit the submarine to a downward maneuver for the current hazard.

abilities.name: Port
abilities.description: Commit the submarine to a port-side maneuver for the current hazard.

abilities.name: Starboard
abilities.description: Commit the submarine to a starboard-side maneuver for the current hazard.

roles.name: Lookout
roles.description: Onboarding: study the chart sent privately by the game master. Identify its hazard family, bearing, marker shape, and grouping, then use concise emoji gestures in Lookout Report during the Report Window. Use ordinary visual ideas such as left, right, above, below, round, pointed, single, pair, or cluster; there is no fixed emoji code. You may edit a message or send a correction.
roles.winCondition: Help the crew clear three hazards before oxygen reaches zero.

roles.name: Sonar Operator
roles.description: Onboarding: listen to the signal sent privately by the game master, or use its accessible transcript. During the Report Window, describe only the raw sequence of low/high and short/long notes in Sonar Report; do not infer or name a maneuver.
roles.winCondition: Help the crew clear three hazards before oxygen reaches zero.

roles.name: Captain
roles.description: Onboarding and Submarine Manual: read both report channels but do not post. Infer the chart's family, bearing, shape, and grouping from the Lookout. Start with the family course: Minefield—port to Ascend, starboard to Starboard, above to Dive, below to Port; Reef Maze—port to Ascend, starboard to Starboard, above to Port, below to Dive; Thermal Vent—port to Ascend, starboard to Starboard, above to Dive, below to Port; Wreck Field—port to Starboard, starboard to Port, above to Dive, below to Ascend; Canyon Current—port to Starboard, starboard to Dive, above to Ascend, below to Port. Apply the visual condition: for Minefield, Reef Maze, or Thermal Vent, rotate once when there are three or four markers; for Wreck Field, rotate twice when there are three or four markers; for Canyon Current, rotate once when the marker is round. Rotate through Ascend, Starboard, Dive, Port. For port or above use Sonar Alphabet A: low = green, short = circle, high = red, long = square. For starboard or below use Alphabet B: low = triangle, short = green, high = cross, long = red. Translate the final sonar note, then rotate once for each translated property that is red, square, or cross. During Command, activate the resulting maneuver; you may undo and choose again until the phase timer ends.
roles.winCondition: Help the crew clear three hazards before oxygen reaches zero.

phases.name: Dive Briefing
phases.description: Prepare the crew, display the current voyage status, and begin the next hazard round.

phases.name: Observation
phases.description: The game master privately announces the chart to the Lookout and the signal with its accessible alternative to the Sonar Operator.

phases.name: Report Window
phases.description: The Lookout and Sonar Operator each send their report while the Captain listens.

phases.name: Command
phases.description: The Captain consults the manual and activates Ascend, Dive, Port, or Starboard.

phases.name: Resolution
phases.description: The game master reveals the hazard, resolves the maneuver, updates the voyage status, and sends the appropriate sound.

achievements.name: Safe Passage
achievements.description: Awarded manually to crew members who complete a three-hazard voyage.

echo-location-cover.description: A stylized submarine travels through dark blue water while sonar rings reveal rocks and distant hazards.

dive-ambience.description: Low submarine-engine ambience with a soft sonar pulse; it contains no gameplay clue.

course-clear.description: A brief bright confirmation chime indicating that the selected maneuver cleared the hazard.

hull-warning.description: A brief low warning alarm indicating that the selected maneuver did not clear the hazard.

safe-passage-badge.description: A gold submarine silhouette inside a circular blue badge with three clear route markers.
